synthesis.procedure: Under an air- and water-free argon or dinitrogen atmosphere, La[N(SiMe3)2]3 and HOBMes2 were combined in toluene at room temperature and stirred for 3 h. Volatiles were removed. The residue was treated twice with hexane, then with THF to precipitate La(OBMes2)3(THF)3; the precipitate was centrifuged and separated from the supernatant. Repeated heating in toluene at 80 °C under reduced pressure removed coordinated THF. The residue was dissolved in minimal hexane and slowly cooled from 0 to −35 °C overnight, giving colorless 1-La crystals.
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature for reaction; 80 °C during desolvation; 0 to −35 °C for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Hexane/THF precipitation, centrifugation, repeated toluene desolvation, and slow cooling from hexane.

synthesis.procedure: Under the stated air- and water-free conditions, HOBMes2 and Nd[N(SiMe3)2]3 were stirred in toluene for 3 h at room temperature. After solvent removal, the residue was crystallized from hexane at −35 °C as 1-Nd. Those crystals were redissolved in hexane, treated with THF, and cooled again to −35 °C for 18 h, giving light-blue 2-Nd crystals.

Solvent was removed from the black supernatant; the residue was dissolved in minimal hexanes and kept at −35 °C for 18 h, yielding black crystalline blocks.

synthesis.procedure: Under the stated air- and water-free conditions, crystals of cluster 6 were dissolved in hexane and treated with crystalline CNXyl. After 30 min of stirring, green solids were filtered away. The filtrate was concentrated, and the residue was dissolved in minimal hot hexanes at about 50 °C. Cooling to room temperature for 18 h yielded orange crystals of the cocrystal 8.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: One reported crystalline material contains two distinct mononuclear Sm(III) molecules: six-coordinate Sm(OBMes2)3(CNXyl)3 and approximately trigonal-bipyramidal Sm(OBMes2)3(CNXyl)(Et2O). The molecules exhibit a xylyl-group stacking contact. The article states that the diffraction data support connectivity rather than detailed metrical analysis.
